title: Gallery card of a background-removed image showed the original
description: A cut-out PNG rendered in the gallery as the untouched source image (white studio backdrop, drop-shadow) while the viewer showed the cut-out. Cause: the 512px gallery thumb was JPG, which has no alpha, and background removal leaves the source RGB intact under the mask — the flatten restored the original rather than painting a backdrop. Image thumbs are now WebP; the load-time backfill re-encodes legacy jpg thumbs of alpha-capable sources.
